build_streaming_transformer: build a StreamingTransformer model with causal attention and configurable checkpointing strategy
create_streaming_transformer_layer: create a StreamingTransformerLayer with cross attention support and layer scaling
build_streaming_multihead_attention: build a StreamingMultiheadAttention module with causal masking and rotary embeddings
create_sin_embedding: create sinusoidal positional embeddings from position tensors with configurable max period
create_layer_scale: create a LayerScale module to rescale residual outputs with a learnable scale parameter
